title: Resource summaries RLS plan
description: Covers student-scoped RLS expectations for automatically generated resource summaries (FR-070).

cases.name: student can select own resource summaries
student cannot select another student's resource summaries
student cannot insert own resource summary
student cannot update own resource summary
student cannot delete own resource summary

ownership_notes: resource summaries are system-written derived artifacts (FR-070), not student input
resource summaries reference public.resources through same-student composite ownership
a superseding prompt_version or summary_strategy_version inserts a new row rather than overwriting (NN-06, ENG-165)
worker mutation relies on service-role bypass
no authenticated insert, update, or delete policy is expected
index_notes: student_id is indexed directly and appears first in composite indexes
resource_id is indexed for per-resource summary retrieval
resource_summaries_student_resource_version_uniq enforces one row per (student, resource, prompt_version, summary_strategy_version)
